sentences.text: The little robot that I built out of a box can move its arms.
sentences.translation_zh: 我用一个盒子做的小机器人能活动手臂。

sentences.text: It seems that the older I get, the more questions I have about the world.
sentences.translation_zh: 好像我越大，对这个世界的问题就越多。

sentences.text: The story was so interesting that I read it twice without stopping.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个故事太有意思了，我一口气读了两遍。

sentences.text: If only I had remembered to bring my camera, I could have taken a picture.
sentences.translation_zh: 要是我记得带相机，就能拍张照片了。

sentences.text: The museum is a place where you can touch and play, not just look.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个博物馆是个能摸、能玩的地方，不只是看。

sentences.text: She spoke as if she had known all of us for years.
sentences.translation_zh: 她说起话来的样子，好像认识我们所有人好多年了。

sentences.text: The forest, which is home to many birds, becomes very quiet in winter.
sentences.translation_zh: 那片住着许多鸟的森林，到了冬天变得非常安静。

sentences.text: I am determined to finish this painting even if it takes all afternoon.
sentences.translation_zh: 我决心画完这幅画，哪怕要花上一整个下午。

sentences.text: The boy refused to give up, even though everyone else had gone home.
sentences.translation_zh: 尽管别人都回家了，那个男孩还是不肯放弃。

sentences.text: It was the first time that I had ever seen snow fall from the sky.
sentences.translation_zh: 那是我第一次看见雪花从天上飘下来。

sentences.text: The teacher noticed that the girl who never spoke had drawn a beautiful picture.
sentences.translation_zh: 老师注意到，那个从不说话的女孩画了一幅很美的画。

sentences.text: Whatever happens, I will always remember the summer we spent together.
sentences.translation_zh: 不管发生什么，我都会一直记得我们一起度过的那个夏天。

sentences.text: The shoes that I have been wearing for a year have finally fallen apart.
sentences.translation_zh: 我穿了一年的那双鞋终于散架了。

sentences.text: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
sentences.translation_zh: 要是我们早点出发，就赶上火车了。

sentences.text: The gift is hidden somewhere that nobody will think of looking.
sentences.translation_zh: 礼物藏在一个谁也想不到会去找的地方。

sentences.text: My mother believes that honesty is more valuable than good marks.
sentences.translation_zh: 妈妈认为诚实比好成绩更宝贵。

sentences.text: The little girl, whose drawings covered the whole wall, wanted to be an artist.
sentences.translation_zh: 那个把整面墙都贴满画的小女孩，想成为一名画家。

sentences.text: We were asked to describe a moment when we felt truly proud of ourselves.
sentences.translation_zh: 我们被要求描述一个真正为自己感到骄傲的时刻。

sentences.text: The river, which flows through the middle of the town, is full of fish.
sentences.translation_zh: 穿城而过的那条河里有很多鱼。

sentences.text: I would rather spend a day in the forest than a whole week shopping.
sentences.translation_zh: 我宁愿在森林里待一天，也不愿逛一整个星期的街。

sentences.text: By the following morning, the snow had covered every path in the garden.
sentences.translation_zh: 到了第二天早上，大雪已经把花园里每条小路都盖住了。

sentences.text: The story teaches children that being brave does not mean never being afraid.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个故事教孩子们：勇敢并不意味着从不害怕。

sentences.text: He was praised for helping a younger child who had lost his way.
sentences.translation_zh: 他因为帮助一个迷路的小弟弟而受到了表扬。

sentences.text: The stars look as though they are moving when you watch them for a while.
sentences.translation_zh: 盯着星星看一会儿，它们看起来好像在移动。

sentences.text: I have been trying to understand how birds can find their way home.
sentences.translation_zh: 我一直想弄明白，鸟是怎么找到回家的路的。

sentences.text: The painting that hung above the fire was painted by my great-grandmother.
sentences.translation_zh: 壁炉上方挂着的那幅画，是我曾祖母画的。

sentences.text: If she had not helped me, I would not have finished the project on time.
sentences.translation_zh: 要不是她帮我，我就不能按时完成这个项目了。

sentences.text: The children, who had been told to wait quietly, began to whisper to each other.
sentences.translation_zh: 被要求安静等待的孩子们，开始互相说起悄悄话来。

sentences.text: There is something magical about the moment when a caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
sentences.translation_zh: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶的那一刻，有一种奇妙的感觉。

sentences.text: The girl asked her father why some people are afraid of spiders.
sentences.translation_zh: 女孩问爸爸，为什么有些人怕蜘蛛。

sentences.text: What surprised us most was how quickly the little bird learned to fly.
sentences.translation_zh: 最让我们惊讶的是，那只小鸟学飞学得那么快。

sentences.text: The old house, which had been empty for years, was full of curious things.
sentences.translation_zh: 那座空了好些年的老房子里，装满了稀奇古怪的东西。

sentences.text: I would have told you earlier if I had known how worried you were.
sentences.translation_zh: 要是我早知道你这么担心，我就会早点告诉你了。

sentences.text: The lessons that you learn slowly often stay with you the longest.
sentences.translation_zh: 慢慢学会的东西，往往陪伴你最久。

sentences.text: My friend, who is usually very calm, shouted with excitement when she saw the whale.
sentences.translation_zh: 我朋友平时很安静，可她看见鲸鱼时兴奋得喊了起来。

sentences.text: The playground is being repainted, so we have to play inside this week.
sentences.translation_zh: 操场正在重新刷漆，所以这周我们只能在室内玩。

sentences.text: It is hard to imagine that the enormous tree once fitted into a tiny seed.
sentences.translation_zh: 很难想象，这棵参天大树当初只是一粒小小的种子。

sentences.text: The children promised that they would meet again when the summer came.
sentences.translation_zh: 孩子们约定，夏天到了再见面。

sentences.text: The story describes a kingdom where nobody has ever been sad.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个故事描述了一个从来没有人难过的王国。

sentences.text: Even though it was only a small part, she played it perfectly.
sentences.translation_zh: 虽然只是个很小的角色，她演得非常出色。

sentences.text: The dog that had followed them all day finally lay down by the fire.
sentences.translation_zh: 跟了他们一整天的那条狗，终于在炉火边趴了下来。

sentences.text: I have learned that making a mistake is often the quickest way to learn.
sentences.translation_zh: 我明白了，犯错常常是最快的学习方式。

sentences.text: The violin, which had been repaired, sounded warmer and deeper than before.
sentences.translation_zh: 修过之后的小提琴，声音比以前更温暖、更深沉。

sentences.text: It was raining so heavily that the streets had turned into small rivers.
sentences.translation_zh: 雨下得太大了，街道都变成了小河。

sentences.text: The girl decided that she would write down every interesting thing she saw.
sentences.translation_zh: 女孩决定，把看到的每件有趣的事都写下来。

sentences.text: The teacher asked us what we would do if we could change one thing in the world.
sentences.translation_zh: 老师问我们，如果能改变世界上的一件事，我们会做什么。

sentences.text: My brother, whose jokes are usually terrible, made everyone laugh that evening.
sentences.translation_zh: 我弟弟平时讲的笑话都很冷，那天晚上却把大家都逗笑了。

sentences.text: The garden was full of flowers that nobody had planted.
sentences.translation_zh: 花园里开满了没人种过的花。

sentences.text: I had never realised how many colours there are in a single forest leaf.
sentences.translation_zh: 我从没意识到，一片森林的叶子上竟然有那么多颜色。

sentences.text: The little boat, which was made of paper, floated down the stream.
sentences.translation_zh: 那只纸做的小船顺着小溪漂走了。

sentences.text: She has been reading the same story since she got home from school.
sentences.translation_zh: 她从学校回家后就一直在读同一个故事。

sentences.text: The town is famous for a bridge that was built more than six hundred years ago.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个镇子因一座六百多年前建成的桥而闻名。

sentences.text: If you look closely, you will notice that the spider is repairing its web.
sentences.translation_zh: 如果你仔细看，就会发现蜘蛛正在修补它的网。

sentences.text: The children were fascinated by the machine that could make pictures move.
sentences.translation_zh: 孩子们被那台能让图画动起来的机器迷住了。

sentences.text: It is said that the lake freezes completely every winter.
sentences.translation_zh: 据说这个湖每年冬天都会完全结冰。

sentences.text: My grandfather, who is nearly eighty, still walks up the hill every morning.
sentences.translation_zh: 我爷爷快八十岁了，仍然每天早上爬那座山。

sentences.text: The girl wondered whether the moon animals could see her from far away.
sentences.translation_zh: 女孩在想，月亮上的动物能不能从很远的地方看见她。

sentences.text: Nothing could persuade the kitten to come down from the top shelf.
sentences.translation_zh: 什么办法都没能劝小猫从最高的架子上下来。

sentences.text: The book, which I had borrowed from the library, was due back today.
sentences.translation_zh: 我从图书馆借的那本书，今天到期要还了。

sentences.text: We had just sat down to eat when the doorbell rang.
sentences.translation_zh: 我们刚坐下要吃饭，门铃就响了。

sentences.text: Whatever she decides to become, her parents will support her.
sentences.translation_zh: 不管她决定成为什么样的人，父母都会支持她。

sentences.text: The bird had built its nest so carefully that the eggs were completely safe.
sentences.translation_zh: 那只鸟把窝搭得那么用心，蛋在里面非常安全。

sentences.text: I would not have believed it if I had not seen it with my own eyes.
sentences.translation_zh: 要不是亲眼看见，我根本不会相信。

sentences.text: The children were asked to imagine a world without any colours.
sentences.translation_zh: 孩子们被要求想象一个没有任何颜色的世界。

sentences.text: The small cafe that we found by accident served the best hot chocolate.
sentences.translation_zh: 我们偶然发现的那家小咖啡馆，热巧克力做得最好喝。

sentences.text: It is important, my grandmother used to say, to be kindest to those who are unkind.
sentences.translation_zh: 奶奶常说，对不友善的人更友善，才是真正重要的。

sentences.text: The moment that the music started, everybody in the room began to dance.
sentences.translation_zh: 音乐一响起，屋里的每个人都跳起舞来。
